verdict.rationale: Evidence is limited to a vague vendor claim about improved ray-tracing making 'games like Control look more compelling' (apple-m4-pro-docs-4/15), with no frame-rate figures, no GPU-class gaming benchmark comparisons, and no independent game benchmark corroboration anywhere in the pack; community commentary even questions whether it's competitive with dedicated gaming GPUs (apple-m4-pro-comm-3) without any answer. missing for 10: quantitative frame-rate claims, independent third-party game benchmarks, GPU-class gaming comparisons.
